2 The objective of the Quantum Computing Certificate program is to prepare those with a degree in a STEM discipline to pivot to a job/career in quantum computing. The demand for a quantum workforce has been emphasized in the National Quantum Initiative Act (https://www.congress.gov/bill/115th-congress/house- bill/6227). For many of those who might be interested, the option of pursuing an MS or PHD is not possible because of time or expense. This certificate will present the information base to allow a person working in industry or government to advance their careers in an exciting new direction.
